name: GetPrice Products
content:
{"xml_header":"<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<STORE URL="{{StoreManager.baseurl}}" DATE="{{date}}" TIME="{{time}}" NAME="{{StoreManager.frontname}}"><PRODUCTS>","feed_xml_item":"PRODUCT NUM="{type='attribute' value='entity_id' format='as_is' length=''  parent='no' cdata='yes'}"","xml_body":"<PRODUCT_NAME><![CDATA[{type="attribute" value="name" format="as_is" length=""  parent="no" cdata="yes"}]]></PRODUCT_NAME>
<CATEGORY_NAME><![CDATA[{type="attribute" value="category" format="as_is" length=""  parent="no" cdata="yes"}]]></CATEGORY_NAME>
<MODEL><![CDATA[{type="attribute" value="sku" format="as_is" length=""  parent="no" cdata="yes"}]]></MODEL>
<DESCRIPTION><![CDATA[{type="attribute" value="description" format="strip_tags" length=""  parent="no" cdata="yes"}]]></DESCRIPTION>
<PROUDUCT_URL><![CDATA[{type="attribute" value="url" format="as_is" length=""  parent="no" cdata="yes"}]]></PROUDUCT_URL>
<PRICE><![CDATA[{type="attribute" value="final_price" format="price" length=""  parent="no" cdata="yes"}]]></PRICE>
<IMAGE><![CDATA[{type="attribute" value="image" format="as_is" length=""  parent="no" cdata="yes"}]]></IMAGE>
<MANUFACTURER><![CDATA[{type="attribute" value="manufacturer" format="as_is" length=""  parent="no" cdata="yes"}]]></MANUFACTURER>
